name: EchoVQA
description: Point-of-care transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) enables cardiac assessment in virtually any clinical setting, yet its diagnostic utility remains constrained by the expertise required for image acquisition and interpretation. Visual question answering (VQA) offers a promising paradigm for bridging this expertise gap through interactive clinical assistance, but existing echocardiography VQA datasets are limited in scale, restricted to high-quality images, and only cover a few views.
